title: Grateful Dead Live at Haight Street on 1968-03-03

ai_review.summary: Historical 1968 Haight‑Street free concert captured from a rough audience tape; the performance is serviceable with a decent Viola Lee Blues, but pitch problems and missing tracks make the recording poor.
ai_review.review: The show offers a glimpse of the Dead’s winter ’68 setlist – highlighted by a solid run of Viola Lee Blues and Smokestack Lightning – but the audio suffers from severe pitch instability, drop‑outs, and missing songs. Reviewers note the historical value of the performance while lamenting the low‑fidelity audience source.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is average to below average (≈3/5) and recording quality is poor (≈2/5); weighted combination yields a rating around 2.8.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Pitch wildly unstable throughout, many sections require manual correction; missing tracks (TiftOO, Dancing in the Streets) and tape artifacts make the audio difficult to listen to.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Standard winter ’68 set; mainly a historical tick‑list rather than a high‑energy performance.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia is heard on a Les Paul with P90s – a short‑lived gear choice noted by reviewers.
